title: On the difficulty of characterizing top trading cycles with identical houses
abstract: arXiv:2611.03251v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study Shapley-Scarf housing markets (Shapley and Scarf, 1974) in which houses come in types and agents are indifferent between houses of the same type but rank the types strictly. On this domain of objective indifferences, top trading cycles (TTC) rules with fixed tie-breaking regain Pareto efficiency and group strategy-proofness (Sandholtz and Tai, 2026), properties that need not hold under general weak preferences. We ask whether the characterization of the TTC rule for strict preferences by Ma (1994) and the characterization of TTC rules with fixed tie-breaking for weak preferences by Ehlers (2014) extend to this domain. They do not. With five agents and two types of houses, we construct a rule that satisfies individual rationality, Pareto efficiency, group strategy-proofness, non-bossiness, and consistency, but whose restriction to the five-agent population is not welfare equivalent to any TTC rule with fixed tie-breaking. translated_title: 论相同房屋情形下刻画顶部交易循环规则的困难性
translated_abstract: 我们研究Shapley-Scarf住房市场（Shapley和Scarf，1974），其中房屋按类型划分，代理人对于同一类型的房屋是无差异的，但对不同类型有严格的排序。在这一客观无差异的领域中，采用固定破平规则的顶部交易循环（TTC）规则重新获得了帕累托效率与群体策略防操纵性（Sandholtz和Tai，2026），而这些性质在一般弱偏好下未必成立。我们探讨Ma（1994）对严格偏好下TTC规则的刻画以及Ehlers（2014）对弱偏好下带固定破平的TTC规则的刻画能否推广到这一领域。结论是不能。通过构造包含五个代理人和两种房屋类型的例子，我们给出了一个满足个体理性、帕累托效率、群体策略防操纵性、非专断性和一致性的规则，但其在五人主体情形下的限制在福利上不等价于任何带固定破平的TTC规则。
tldr: 本文证明Ma（1994）与Ehlers（2014）对顶部交易循环规则的公理化刻画无法推广到房屋按类型划分且存在客观无差异的Shapley-Scarf住房市场领域。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the classical axiomatizations of top trading cycles rules by Ma (1994) and Ehlers (2014) fail to extend to Shapley-Scarf housing markets where houses come in types and agents share objective indifferences.
